title: Sources Sought: 142WG B155 AD/AL Communications Annex Construction
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > NGB > W7NW USPFO ACTIVITY ORANG 142
description:
This Sources Sought notice concerns a construction requirement anticipated to be acquired as a commercial acquisition under the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR Parts 12, 14, 15, and 36. Interested parties are advised that the structure, procedures, and clauses of any resulting solicitation may differ from those customarily used for construction acquisitions. 

 Unless expressly stated otherwise, references to the FAR in this notice and in any resulting solicitation refer to the FAR and DFARS as revised by the RFO and implemented through the applicable Department of Defense class deviations. 

 This Sources Sought Solicitation is being issued in accordance with FAR Part 10,  Market Research .  The purpose of this notice is to gain knowledge of potential sources for this project including interested Small Business Concerns.  Its sole purpose is to provide information for planning and market research purposes only and shall not be construed as either a solicitation or obligation on the part of the Government.  The Government welcomes responses from all interested parties; however, no decision or award of contract will be made based on responses from industry.  The Government will not pay for the preparation of, nor the subsequent use of, information submitted in response to this Solicitation.  Respondents will not be notified of the outcome of the Government’s review of the information received.  Additionally, the Government does not intend to hold discussions concerning this potential solicitation with any interested parties but reserves the right to contact vendors if additional information is required for clarifications as it pertains to the Solicitation. 

  Project Information  

 The Contractor shall provide non-personal services, to include all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary for the Add/Alter (AD/AL) construction of a Communications Annex facility at Portland Air National Guard Base (PANGB), Portland, OR.  The magnitude of construction for this effort is $10,000,000 to $25,000,000. 

 This project is to construct an addition (8,742 SQF) to communications facility B155 to support radio maintenance, administrative, storage functions and the Joint Incident Site Communications Capability (JISCC) utilizing conventional design and construction methods to accommodate the mission of the facility. Alter Communications B155 (5,084 SQF): Repair roof, patch exterior insulation and finish system, paint facility exterior, and replace existing maintenance intensive landscaping with basic grass/mulch per base standards.  Repair by replacement of the HVAC throughout administrative/office areas and repair the server room HVAC system.  Repair office interiors to increase space flexibility.  Install fire suppression throughout facility and repair existing fire alarms.  Renovate facility to meet current seismic and anti-terrorism/forcer protection requirements. Provide temporary facilities for displaced functions during construction. Facilities have been designed as permanent construction in accordance with the DoD Unified Facilities Criteria (UFC) 1-200-01, General Building Requirements and UFC 1-200-02, High Performance and Sustainable Building Requirements.  Construction shall be compatible with applicable DoD, Air Force, and base design standards. In addition, local materials and construction techniques shall be used where cost effective. This project will comply with DoD antiterrorism/force protection requirements per unified facilities criteria.  Special Construction Requirements: Facility shall be constructed in accordance with Oregon Department of Environmental Quality storm water requirements and include necessary drainage improvements and a Contaminated Material Management Plan. 

 The NAICS code for this requirement is 236220,  Commercial and Institutional Building Construction .  The Small Business Administration size standard for small businesses in this industry is $45,000,000. 

  Instructions to Interested Firms  

 All interested concerns should submit a written notice, not to exceed five (5) pages, stating the concern’s positive intention to submit an intent for proposal as a prime contractor no later than the deadline posted with this notice.  Responses to this Sources Sought should include the following information: 

 
	 A positive statement of intent to submit a proposal as a prime contractor, 
	 A listing of relevant projects completed during the past five (5) years for both Government and private industry.  The list should provide the type of project, dollar value, contract number, location, and point(s) of contact.  Also, please indicate whether the firm was a prime or subcontractor—if the firm was a subcontractor, please provide a point of contact with the prime contractor, 
	 A brief outline of resources, subcontractors, and key personnel that would be used to accomplish the contract, and 
	 Demonstration of the firm’s socioeconomic status (i.e., SB, 8(a), HUBZone, EDWOSB, WOSB, SDVOSB, etc.), and size. 
 

 If adequate small business firms are not available for adequate competition for this project, it may be advertised as an unrestricted solicitation. 

 Submit responses directly to kalene.kaplan.1@us.af.mil; telephone calls and facsimile responses will not be honored.  Please reference the Notice ID and project title in the subject of your message.  Please limit your responses to standard documents (i.e., Microsoft Office, Adobe PDF, etc.).  Do not send compressed (i.e., .zip or .exe extension) or other file types as they will be stripped from your message.
